title: On a phone Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's arrow behaviour
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its card shows one "Sales Representative" field reading "Unassigned".
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open on a phone (a touch screen with no mouse pointer).
  • The browser window is a phone screen, and the design pictures "phone-00-b-phone-details.png" (board 6.0) and "phone-01-b-phone-open.png" (board 6.1) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Tap the card's edit button to expand it.
  2. Tap Lead Technician.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the card expands with the same control as before. Without tapping them, Lead Technician and Service Advisor look as they do today: no arrow until tapped (while the Sales Representative field already shows its arrow).
  • Step 2: the arrow shows once the field is tapped, and its dropdown opens as today.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone)

  • S3-R4: “Nothing in the fields or the buttons depends on hover. On a touch screen the Sales Representative fields always show their dropdown arrow, as the + and remove x buttons always do. Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's behavior, where the arrow shows once the field is tapped.”
  • S3-R6: “On a phone the work order card opens collapsed, without Lead Technician, Service Advisor or the Sales Representative fields. They show after the card is expanded with its edit button, as Lead Technician and Service Advisor do today. The expand control itself does not change.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
